definitions.gloss: number of votes; vote count; ballot count
definitions.explanation: The total number of votes cast in an election, poll, or any kind of voting process. Frequently used in news reporting about elections and surveys.

examples.japanese: {投票数|とうひょうすう}は{過去最高|かこさいこう}だった。
examples.english: The number of votes was the highest ever.

examples.japanese: {有効|ゆうこう}{投票数|とうひょうすう}の{過半数|かはんすう}を{獲得|かくとく}した。
examples.english: They obtained a majority of the valid votes.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{選挙|せんきょ}では{前回|ぜんかい}より{投票数|とうひょうすう}が{大幅|おおはば}に{増|ふ}え、{有権者|ゆうけんしゃ}の{関心|かんしん}の{高|たか}さがうかがえた。
examples.english: In this election, the vote count increased significantly compared to last time, indicating the high level of interest among eligible voters.

notes:
Composed of {投票|とうひょう} (voting; casting a ballot) and {数|すう} (number; count). A standard term in political reporting and election coverage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {投票数|とうひょうすう}が{増|ふ}える: the vote count increases
- {投票数|とうひょうすう}が{減|へ}る: the vote count decreases
- {有効|ゆうこう}{投票数|とうひょうすう}: number of valid votes
- {無効|むこう}{投票数|とうひょうすう}: number of invalid votes
- {総|そう}{投票数|とうひょうすう}: total number of votes

RELATED WORDS:
- {投票率|とうひょうりつ}: voter turnout rate
- {得票数|とくひょうすう}: number of votes received (by a candidate)
- {開票|かいひょう}: vote counting; ballot opening
